current.text: He is projected to start at forward with Haliburton, Nembhard, Nesmith and Zubac.
With Haliburton back, his assists should drop to about 3 to 3.2 per game and his usage should fall back under 30.
In category leagues he is worth a pick in the 50 to 60 range. ESPN's rank of about 24 to 25 is far too high, and pick 45 is too early.
At age 32, aging is a question for him.
Coach Rick Carlisle likes to keep minutes down even for healthy players and to rest players on back-to-backs. Indiana has 15 back-to-backs this season.
Indiana plays 3, 4 and 3 games in our fantasy playoff weeks (season ending March 28), which is not ideal.
Indiana is projected to win 46 to 48 games and finish as a top-six seed in the East.

durable.text: He is worth much more in points leagues than in category leagues.
Free throw percentage is his weak category, about 72%. He is also poor in defensive stats, with few blocks for a forward or center.
Points are his best category, and he adds good FG% on real volume.
His production is very consistent from game to game, at about 22 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists. His game-to-game range is one of the tightest in the NBA.
He plays through minor problems and plays a lot when he is able to.

note: Experts put him in the 50 to 60 range in category leagues. Yahoo's 17 USD value (rank 59) fits that. ESPN's 29 USD (rank 25) and the 25 USD he cost in our league last season are bust prices for a player whose assists and usage should drop with Haliburton back. He is a solid punt FT% piece with F and C eligibility. Early in the season, check his assists, his usage next to Haliburton and whether Carlisle trims his minutes or rests him on back-to-backs.
